visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short, dark bob-style hair, wearing a black one-shoulder top and a silver necklace with an 'H' pendant, stands against a plain off-white wall. She gestures with her fingers while speaking directly to the camera with high facial expressiveness. (2) A sequence of close-ups features a black Bobbi Brown cosmetic jar being held and opened to reveal a peach-colored cream. A hand swatches the smooth cream on the back of a wrist, demonstrating its texture and blendability. (3) A grid-like shot displays ten open jars of various pink, red, and peach shades arranged on a white surface. The camera focus is sharp on the product textures, showing differences in pigment. (4) The woman applies the cream to her cheeks and eyelids using her fingertips, looking toward the lens. She demonstrates blending the 'Muted Peach' shade into her skin, highlighting her natural-looking makeup. (5) A close-up of an arm shows five distinct color swatches labeled with English text. The colors range from light pink to deep plum, shown under bright, even lighting to emphasize color accuracy. (6) The woman returns to the initial medium shot, holding the product jar and giving a thumbs-up while continuing her energetic presentation, concluding with smiles and head tilts.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 最近專櫃. (2) [Subtitle]: 百元的 唇頰霜嗎?. (3) [Subtitle]: 它妝感 上起來超美 還可以完成2025 最流行的 one-tone 全臉同色系妝容. (4) [Logo]: BOBBI BROWN. [Subtitle]: Bobbi Brown新出的 雲朵唇頰霜. (5) [Subtitle]: 這顆我期待它上市 有一段時間了 沒想到它這麼大容量 竟然千元有找. (6) [Subtitle]: 它是 有點絲絨的質地 很好暈染 而且也很服貼肌膚. (7) [Subtitle]: 總共有出10色 我今天示範 最喜歡的 Muted Peach. (8) [Subtitle]: 它是非常 適合黃皮膚的 #肉桂裸色. (9) [Subtitle]: 低飽和色系用指腹啊 或是矽膠刷輕輕拍開 就很好看. (10) [Subtitle]: 而且它非常的好暈染 不像有些粉狀腮紅 就是容易結塊 或是暈不開. (11) [Subtitle]: 加上它剛剛好的顯色度 不容易失手 所以可以非常的自然 融入你的皮膚中. (12) [Subtitle]: 輕鬆就可以 暈染出 超有氛圍感的妝容. (13) [Subtitle]: 各位懶人們 也可以直接 拿來上眼影跟唇彩. (14) [Subtitle]: 一顆搞定妝容色彩 是不是超級簡單快速. (15) [Subtitle]: 那我也試其他幾個色 在手上給你們做參考. (16) [Logo]: Petal Pink, Muted Peach, Tea Rose, Claret, Soft Plum. (17) [Subtitle]: 這顆啊我有帶去日本旅行 必須說它的持妝度 真的蠻優秀的. (18) [Subtitle]: 不用擔心腮紅到晚上消失不見 我到卸妝前 它還是乖乖的在臉上. (19) [Subtitle]: 所以喜歡腮紅霜的 可以買!
